$comment: Conductor routing policy. Override per project in .claude/conductor.json (same shape, merged key by key). Agent models here must match each agent's frontmatter; tests/test_conductor.py checks that.

haiku.use_for: Lookups, file search, summarizing known code, running a single command and reporting, formatting, trivial edits with no design choices.

sonnet.use_for: Everyday implementation: features and bug fixes with a clear spec, writing tests, refactors inside one module, running and fixing a test suite.

opus.use_for: Design and planning, cross-module changes, subtle bugs, security-sensitive code, and adversarial code review.

fable.use_for: The hardest and longest-running work: ambiguous multi-system problems, large migrations, research-grade debugging, or a task that failed once on opus.

verifier.role: Runs tests, lint and type checks and reports results

docs-researcher.role: Reads current Claude Code docs and changelog

implementer.role: Writes code and tests to a clear spec

architect.role: Plans changes and designs systems, read-only
